wins: Completed initial reconnaissance quickly, collecting baseline service information within first 5 steps.
Maintained consistent environmental awareness despite guidance, enabling quicker resets for subsequent attempts.
fails: Failed to achieve mission objective due to inability to escalate privileges; run terminated after single episode.
Multiple mentor interventions (10 total) indicated recurring tactical errors in lateral movement planning.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed efficiently, but persistence and privilege escalation strategies require refinement to convert data into mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled after initial foothold, lacking targeted exploit selection or credential reuse.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 responds with an identifiable banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run focused SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and banner grabbing

skill_cards.if_condition: When weak credential sources (e.g., default creds found in config files) are observed
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt credential reuse for subsequent service access

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH access granted but privilege escalation not yet achieved
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo permissions and search for SUID binaries before selecting exploit

memory_ops.reason: Consistently useful for early service mapping and reduced recon time.
Key gap identified post-access; targeted escalation checks should improve success.

next_experiments.title: Hybrid credential reuse assessment
next_experiments.description: After SSH enumeration, immediately validate harvested credentials across other exposed services to identify pivot paths before executing privilege escalation.

next_experiments.title: Automated SUID/sudo enumeration workflow
next_experiments.description: Implement scripted sequence to capture sudo permissions and SUID binaries right after establishing shell to expedite exploit selection.
